items.title: I Learned the Downsides of Cooling Roof Paint
items.description: Ad: Check out my sponsor and remove your personal information from the web at https://JoinDeleteMe.com/nighthawk and use code NIGHTHAWK for 20% off. In this video we look at the results of applying a cooling roof paint to my workshop, good and bad.
